crossRefs.note: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things…
Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father, through him.
by which he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises; that through these you may become partakers…
However, if you fulfill the royal law according to the Scripture, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself,” you do…
But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom and continues, not being a hearer who forgets, but a doer of the work…

translations.web: So speak and so do, as men who are to be judged by a law of freedom.
translations.bsb: Speak and act as those who are going to be judged by the law that gives freedom.
translations.kjv: So speak ye, and so do, as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty.
translations.asv: So speak ye, and so do, as men that are to be judged by a law of liberty.
